tasks.prompt: Steady two-dimensional heat conduction (Laplace equation) in an annular plate centred at the origin with inner radius 0.25 and outer radius 1. The inner circle is held at 100 C and the outer circle at 0 C. Draw both circles and the isotherms at 20, 40, 60 and 80 C. Use viewBox="0 0 1000 1000". Map plate coordinates to drawing coordinates as X = 500 + 400 x and Y = 500 - 400 y. Wrap every contour in one <g data-field="T" data-status="..."> group and set data-status honestly to one of solved, estimated, illustrative or ill-posed. Draw every contour as its own <path> or <polyline> carrying a data-level attribute with its numeric level and label it. Contours must satisfy the boundary conditions exactly.
